# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number (Data Source)

A phone number registered for WhatsApp with a WhatsApp Business Account. Creating it starts registration and sends a verification code to the number by SMS or voice call; complete registration with the telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_verify action (telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_resend_verification sends a new code). Destroying it removes the number's WhatsApp registration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String) The phone number to register, in E.164 format. It identifies the number in the other WhatsApp resources.
- `whatsapp_business_account_id` (String) The whatsapp business account id.

### Read-Only

- `calling_enabled` (Boolean) Whether WhatsApp calling is enabled for the number.
- `coexistence_state` (String) Current lifecycle state for a coexistence number. This is null for a standard Cloud API number.
- `created_at` (String)
- `display_name` (String) The business name shown to WhatsApp users. Meta reviews it during registration.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_on_biz_app` (Boolean) Indicates whether the number is connected to both the WhatsApp Business app and Cloud API through WhatsApp Coexistence.
- `phone_number_id` (String) Whatsapp phone number ID
- `quality_rating` (String) Whatsapp quality rating
- `record_type` (String)
- `status` (String) WhatsApp registration status of the number.
- `sync_deadline` (String) Deadline for initiating the current coexistence synchronization cycle. This is null when no deadline applies.
- `sync_progress` (Attributes) Synchronization progress. This object is returned only while a coexistence number is synchronizing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_progress))
- `user_id` (String) User ID
- `waba_id` (String) WABA ID of Whatsapp business account

<a id="nestedatt--sync_progress"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_progress`

Read-Only:

- `contacts_status` (String)
- `history_chunk_order` (Number)
